name: lode
description: Agentic coding persistent memory: capture the why, then compound it into reports, reviews, and decision roadmaps.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory and decision replay for agentic coding
interface.longDescription: Capture session decisions, abandoned paths, risks, and open questions, then reuse them for recall, daily notes, weekly outlines, monthly reviews, and decision roadmaps.
defaultPrompt: Use Lode to capture this session with /lode:capture.
Use Lode to recall recent project decisions with /lode:recall.
Use Lode to query cited decision evidence with /lode:query.
